sources.L_selected: 78FR inductors measured on the VNA and binned to +/-3 % (procedure in bring-up doc)
sources.C_C0G_G: KEMET C315 C0G radial +/-2 % (G), e.g. C315C101G1G5TA
sources.rail: LM317 VREF 1.20-1.30 V (TI datasheet min/max) with 1 % R10/R11: rail 9.81 V +/-4.5 %

model_provenance: 2N3904/2N3906: simplified Gummel-Poon models (mfg=NXP) from the LTspice standard.bjt library, mirror github.com/mpkopec/ltspice-lib cmp/standard.bjt. They have no ISE/NE low-current beta droop, no fT-versus-current roll-off beyond IKF, and fixed junction capacitances. Sampling: BF spans the datasheet hFE range at 10 mA (100-300 for both types), and IS is log-uniform x0.56-1.79 (about +/-15 mV Vbe, lot-to-lot). TF and CJC are not sampled; they are tested as deliberate corners (x0.7 and x1.4) because the models' dynamic parameters are the least certain.
